```plato
//==
// # FunctionalProcedural
//
// Derived functionality for the function-like interfaces
// (`functional.concepts.plato`): batch evaluation, bijection round trips, and
// the accessors over a preferred parameter domain
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Domain_of_a_function). Shared provenance note:
// `collections.library.plato`.

library FunctionalProcedural
{
    //==
    // # IProcedural
    //
    // Evaluation over a batch of inputs. The result collection is constructed by
    // the Array.Map intrinsic, so this no longer needs an interface that can build
    // one.

    // Evaluate the mapping at every input, preserving order. Result element i is
    // Eval(inputs[i]).
    EvalAll(self: IProcedural<$TDomain, $TRange>, inputs: Array<$TDomain>): Array<$TRange>
        => inputs.Map(input => self.Eval(input));
```
